# GuoLingZhi Network

> Official casual and puzzle mobile game portfolio by GuoLingZhi Network. Over 129 published titles available on Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store).

## Overview
- **Studio**: GuoLingZhi Network (郭凌智网络)
- **Website**: https://gkismet.github.io/
- **Google Play**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=5233851887688172838
- **Apple App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/id1570422966
- **Business Contact**: classicgamepuzzle2020@gmail.com
- **Privacy Policy**: https://gkismet.github.io/PrivacyPolicy.txt
- **app-ads.txt**: https://gkismet.github.io/app-ads.txt

## Key Featured Titles
- [Merge Puzzle 2048](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.x2blocks.puzzlegame.number.merge): Number merging 2048 blocks puzzle game. Also on [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1627699192).
- [Mahjong-Puzzle Games](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mahjong.free.puzzlegame): Classic solitaire tile matching game. Also on [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/1643478309).
- [Puzzle Test Master](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puzzledom.blockpuzzle.dice): Addictive block and dice brain challenges. Also on [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1615961261).
- [Avatar Maker-Comics](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dressup.vlinder.avatar.maker.comics): Cartoon character styling and dress-up. Also on [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/6443975845).
- [Water Sort Color](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=water.sort.puzzlegame.soda): Color liquid sorting relaxing puzzle. Also on [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1634198117).
